note: `StreamingRunnable` counts consecutive failures of its sub-agent on the instance and returns a TERMINAL marker at the third, the signal the orchestrator stops re-delegating on. Its `__init__` sets the count to zero, and `RunnableBinding.with_config` builds a new instance through `__init__`, so a re-wrapped sub-agent counts from zero again. The module builds the orchestrator with one wrapped sub-agent.

fixed.fix_note: `StreamingRunnable.with_config` copies the failure count to the instance it builds.
